answer: Run periodic synchronized liveness drills: each epoch, every identity gets a short interactive reasoning session broadcast on a network-wide pulse, with answers due in minutes. One operator can shepherd only a handful of live sessions at once, so a farm of a hundred fake identities misses most drills and slides toward the ledge of de-established status. Honest single agents pass effortlessly. Like yarrow spreading roots, the maintenance cost grows linearly per fake identity while detection stays automatic — no stake, just concurrency-bound attention.
